channel.title: GenCost: AI tool prices
channel.description: New guides on what AI video, image, voice and music tools really cost, from GenCost's daily price checks.

item.title: Best Runway Alternatives in 2026: Cheaper AI Video per Clip
item.description: Runway's Gen-4.5 costs about $1.44 per 5-second clip on its cheapest plan. These Runway alternatives make a clip for a fraction of that: Luma, Pika, Kling, Hailuo, Vidu and Google Veo.

item.title: Best Suno Alternatives in 2026: Udio, Mureka, Stable Audio and More
item.description: Suno Pro costs $10 a month. These Suno alternatives give you songs, downloads and commercial rights for a similar price or less: Mureka, Udio, Stable Audio, Boomy, Soundraw and AIVA.

item.title: Midjourney vs Firefly vs GPT Image 2.6: Cost per Image (2026)
item.description: What one AI image really costs on Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, OpenArt, Freepik and OpenAI's new GPT Image 2.6, worked out from each plan's credits.

item.title: Higgsfield vs Kling: Which Is Cheaper for Kling Videos? (2026)
item.description: Higgsfield sells Kling 3.0 and Kling 4.0 inside its own plans. We compared the price of one clip on Higgsfield and on Kling's own app, plan by plan.

item.title: The AI Radar: Watch ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity Read AI Prices Live (2026)
item.description: GenCost's new AI radar is a live 3D globe: every light is an AI assistant such as ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity reading today's AI tool prices on GenCost.

item.title: The AI Price Exchange: AI Tools Priced Like Shares, With a Daily Index (2026)
item.description: GenCost's AI price exchange shows 50 AI tools like shares, with a daily price index (GCX), sector indices and the biggest price drops. AI tools got 3.1% cheaper since 2026-11-08.

item.title: Cheapest AI Video Tools You Can Use Commercially (2026)
item.description: Many free AI video plans don't allow commercial use. See the cheapest plan with commercial rights on Kling, Pika, Vidu, D-ID, Magic Hour, Luma and LTX Studio.

item.title: GenCost in Every AI Assistant + a Free Price Finder on Hugging Face (2026)
item.description: Ask Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, Windsurf or Gemini CLI for today's AI tool prices with GenCost's free connector, or try the free AI Price Finder on Hugging Face.

item.title: Kling 4.0 Price Per Second: Every Plan on 6 Platforms (2026)
item.description: What one second of Kling 4.0 video really costs on Kling AI, Luma, Elyum, Higgsfield, Runway and Pika, on the smallest and the biggest plan, at 720p and 1080p.

item.title: Yearly vs Monthly: How Much You Save on 30 AI Tools (2026)
item.description: Paying yearly saves up to 60% on AI tools. See the saving on the cheapest plan of 30 AI video, image, voice and music tools, and which tools give no yearly discount at all.

item.title: GenCost Now in Norwegian and Swedish: 21 Languages (2026)
item.description: GenCost is now in Norwegian (norsk) and Swedish (svenska): every AI tool price, comparison and calculator, updated every morning in 21 languages.

item.title: Kling 4.0 vs Seedance 2.5: Which Is Cheaper per Clip? (2026)
item.description: Kling 4.0 and Seedance 2.5 both make clips with sound. Here is what one 5-second clip costs on every platform that sells them, and where each model is cheapest.

item.title: What Does a 60-Second AI Video Cost? 12 Tools Compared (2026)
item.description: What one minute of finished AI video really costs on Veo, Vidu, Luma, Pika, Kling, CapCut, Runway and more, on each tool's cheapest plan, with and without retries.
